rhythm.sermon: Love your neighbour — even the one whose geese are in your cabbages.
A kind word costs nothing, and buys more than a crown.
Who mends a neighbour's fence mends his own heart.
Do not sell the miller short, nor let the miller sell you short.
The field gives to the hand that works it. So does the soul.
Rest today, and let the oxen rest. They have earned it more than most of you.
Bear your neighbour's burden, and you'll find your own the lighter.
Pride is a heavy coat in summer. Take it off.
The stranger at the gate may be the friend you have not met.
Give the widow her due weight. The scales remember.
Anger is a fire in your own thatch. Put it out before it spreads.
Pay the labourer his wage by dusk, and sleep easy.
Forgive as you would be forgiven, and quicker than you'd like.
Even the smallest candle pushes back the dark.
Honest bread is sweeter than a stolen feast.
Speak well of the absent. They cannot answer for themselves.
A soft answer turns away wrath. A hard one sends it home with you.
Look after the old ones. You will be old sooner than you think.
Share the harvest, and the lean year will share with you.
Mind your tongue at the tavern, and your purse at the market.
We are all guests here, and the house is not ours to wreck.
Patience grows like an oak: slowly, and then it shelters many.

rhythm.sermon.text: Keep a warm hearth and an open door through the long winter.
Rest in the heat of the day, and rise to serve in the cool of it.

rhythm.porch: Fine words this morning, weren't they?
Did you hear him on the geese? Meant for Tomas, that was.
Shall we walk out to the green after?
My knees are not made for those pews.
Who was that snoring at the back?
Come by for dinner, both of you.
{service} always runs long when there's gossip to get to.
rhythm.priest_regular: Good to see you again, {player}. Peace be with you.
You keep coming back, {player}. That does an old priest good.
rhythm.watch_call: {hour} o'clock! Bar your doors, mind your fires!
{hour} of the clock, and a quiet night!

rhythm.watch_call.text: {hour} o'clock, and a cold one! Bank your fires!

rhythm.watch_challenge: Late to be abroad, {player}. Mind how you go.
Step into the light where I can see you.
rhythm.curfew: Bell's gone. Off home with you.
That's the bell. Home now, unless you've business with the watch.
rhythm.toast: To {lord}'s health — may he pay for the next one!
To good bread and better beer!
To {settlement}, and all who drink in her!
To dry boots and full bellies!

rhythm.toast.text: To the snow staying on the mountain!
To the sea, and the fish in it!

rhythm.arm_wrestle: Come on, put your back into it!
Best of three. Best of three!
rhythm.round: A round from {player}! Drink up, all!
rhythm.closing: Time, gentlemen! Haven't you homes to go to?
That's the last of it. Off with you, and quietly.
rhythm.homeward: The road's moving. Is the road moving?

{child}! Wash your hands and come in!
rhythm.washer: ...and she said the miller's boy had been seen at the mill pond.

rhythm.washer.text: Hurry, before the sun's too high.

rhythm.seek_count: ...eight, nine, ten! Ready or not, here I come!

rhythm.play: I'm the captain of the guard!
